tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground behind every surface. A step darker than surface so cards and the table frame read as separate layers.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Table, side panel, buttons, inputs. Everything you read or click sits on surface.

tokens.name: raise
tokens.usage: Hover fill for rows and squares; agent monogram fill; loading placeholder bars.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Borders of cards, controls and the header rule. Decorative only, never the only sign of a control.

tokens.name: line-subtle
tokens.usage: Row dividers and column dividers inside the table.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text: skill names, headings, values. Also the fill of the dark secondary button (Fix one by one).

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Body sentences: panel explanations, banner detail.

tokens.name: mute
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, counts, captions, Off and Off in settings words. 5.3:1 on bg light, 8.0:1 on surface dark.

tokens.name: text-faint
tokens.usage: Quietest readable text: folder paths, Not here. Lowest grey allowed for text: at least 4.7:1 light and 5.6:1 dark on every surface, hover included.

tokens.name: mark-faint
tokens.usage: Shapes only: the Off ring and the Not here dash. Never text (fails 4.5:1).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one signal colour: the primary action, the On mark, links, focus rings, the selected square outline.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on accent (primary button label). 6.1:1 light, 8.3:1 dark.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected square fill, pressed toggle fill, tip and refresh banners.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Text for Different copies and the attention banner title. 6.7:1 on warn-soft.

tokens.name: warn-mark
tokens.usage: The Different diamond mark only. A shape colour, not text.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Attention banner ground.

tokens.name: warn-line
tokens.usage: Attention banner border and its button borders.

tokens.name: bad
tokens.usage: Can't read: the cross mark and its word. Differs from warn in lightness as well as hue.

tokens.name: bad-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind a Can't read message block.

tokens.name: toast
tokens.usage: Undo bar ground: the one inverted surface.

tokens.name: on-toast
tokens.usage: Text and Undo button on the Undo bar.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

styles.name: title-page
styles.usage: One per page: the page title.

styles.name: title-panel
styles.usage: The skill name at the top of the side panel and sheets.

styles.name: title-banner
styles.usage: Attention banner, card titles and empty-state headline.

styles.name: title-doc
styles.usage: Section headings inside a rendered skill document (Document).

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Plain-sentence explanations in the side panel.

styles.name: doc
styles.sample: Write a test that fails for the right reason before you change any code.
styles.usage: Body text of a rendered skill document: longer line height for reading.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Review a diff for bugs before you commit.
styles.usage: Default text, banner detail, form text.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: Buttons, navigation, skill names in rows (at 600).

styles.name: cell
styles.usage: The status word inside a square; secondary descriptions.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Column headers, small section labels, row verdicts (at 500).

styles.name: path
styles.usage: Folder paths only. Never skill names or body text.

styles.name: file-text
styles.usage: Exact file content: the editor, the File text view, code blocks inside a document, diff lines.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap inside a keycap pair; icon to text nudge.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between toolbar controls and between mark and word.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding block, gap from verdict to description.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Square side padding; gap from table to panel on phone.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Row side padding; gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Side panel padding; gap between table and side panel.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Header gap between logo, nav and search.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Page side margins on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Keycaps and agent monograms.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: The large primary button in the side panel.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Table frame and attention banner.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Side panel and cards; top corners of the phone sheet (18px there).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Now and After pills, counts.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: The side panel only, to lift the answer above the table.

tokens.name: shadow-toast
tokens.usage: The Undo bar and the phone bottom sheet.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Height of buttons and inputs on desktop, and of buttons inside cards and panels.

tokens.name: control-page
tokens.usage: Height of page-level actions in a title row or page footer: New skill, Edit, Save to 3 places, Create, Go to Skills.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Height of the side panel primary button.

tokens.name: touch
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of anything tappable on phones.

tokens.name: square
tokens.usage: Minimum height of a table row and its squares.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the side panel.
